indices.title: Equity commentary
indices.body:
Equities are up overnight, with the Nasdaq up 1.06% and SPY up .84%.

VIX has retreated to 15.6.

The market made a strong bid from the lows of the Thursday session. If NQ holds above the QQQ 740 pivot, good chance of continuation. Breadth is still poor and I'm looking to see if the other sectors finally catch up or current leaders roll over for a more directional move.

Brent crude has given up yesterday's gains, selling from 91 to 89 amid speculation the EU may release its diesel reserves. The just-released jobs report showed a cool print for the labor market, with Polymarket odds showing near-certainty on a no-touch Fed in October (88%).

Treasury yields are showing signs of cooling off.

bonds.title: Bond commentary
bonds.body: Treasury yields are still extremely elevated, and continue to create downward pressure on equities. Energy prices and concerns over government spending will be the key drivers.
